company.description:
BotOn is a business intelligence platform aiming to centralize automotive and mobility framework data to create market intelligence.

The platform connect vehicles by detecting VIN and decode model and brand. Processes data, so that the user is aware of what is happening inside its vehicle and connect it to the user's current device ecosystem. It also gives actionable insights to know the better routes, high demand areas, or fleet behaviour. It Optimizes and develops new business models.

The company was founded in 2017 in Madrid, Madrid.
